title: Where to put a few moorings to monitor the upper ocean
query: Treat the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity and velocity for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E) as the true ocean. Suppose three to five moorings measuring temperature and salinity from the surface to 1000 m could be deployed. Determine where they should be placed so that together they best represent the monthly variability of upper-ocean temperature and salinity over the whole region, how much of that variability they would capture, how the best sites change with the quantity and the depth range to be monitored, and how robust the design is to the years used to derive it. State what a design based on a reanalysis and on monthly means cannot guarantee.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
